## Diagram Legend

- **Solid arrows (`-->`):** Component-to-component flow within systems
- **Double arrows (`<-->`):** Bidirectional system integration
- **Dotted arrows (`-.->`):** Component-to-system integration points
- **Color coding:**
  - Layer colors: Distinct colors for each of 6 layers
  - Component colors: Styled by component kind (core, storage, pipeline, etc.)

## Usage

This ultra-complex diagram provides complete visibility into the AIM-OS architecture. Use it to understand:

- System internal structure (components within each system)
- Component relationships (how components interact)
- System integrations (how systems connect)
- Integration points (which components handle external connections)
